chronology: Exploratory follow-up fixed after the original PCA, external-phase and original full-size SAE results. The common-inference execution is ongoing; no signed-weight gene contributions or projected-score fidelity diagnostics have been inspected.
question: Can the original control-annotated Cycling PCA score rise through decreases of genes with negative component weights while external phase-marker scores fall? This asks about a numerical projection, not biological mechanism or PCA failure.
input: Identical normalized111445 x4081 expression bytes, verified against the primary checkpoint. Original PCA model SHA and phase comparison CSV SHA must match archived records. Component3, positive orientation, was selected before this diagnostic by the original control annotation.
original_scores: Use the recovered fit_transform scores from the common-inference run only after its strict945-comparison recovery check passes. A later X@components projection is not presumed identical to randomized-SVD fit_transform.
fidelity_gate: Compute the saved linear projection in double precision. Report normalized RMSE against recovered original scores over all cells (divided by original-score SD) and maximum absolute difference of the105 inference-control stratified AUCs. Only if RMSE<=.01 and maxAUCdifference<=.005 may its descriptive mean attribution be used to discuss the original score. Otherwise retain all estimates as a different projection and explicitly withhold the original-score explanation. No parameter or threshold tuning.
decomposition: For each of all105 singles, compute each gene's contribution w_j*(meanX_pert-meanX_inference_control) within every gemgroup. Average using fixed n_pert*n_control pair weights, matching the AUC's partition weights. Verify the sum equals the weighted projected mean difference to numerical tolerance. Retain all4081 gene contributions, not selected positive genes alone.
partitions: Partition input genes into requested external S/G2M marker union vs other genes, crossed with positive, negative or zero component weight. Report exact coverage; genes absent from the PCA input have zero contribution by construction but may enter the separate phase scores. Save sums for all six classes and the complete gene table. Mean contributions do not decompose ranks or AUCs.
descriptive_summaries: Retain all105 perturbations. Tabulate how many have original PCA AUC>=.55 with both external phase AUCs<=.45, and how many of those have positive projected mean change and a net positive contribution from the negative-weight class. Record original and newly joint-corrected PCA association flags separately without making a new significance claim. Compare to all105, report negative and incompatible cases too. No gene-level hypothesis tests, new regulator claims or selected p-value searches.
outputs: Fresh separate output JSON, all105 summary rows and losslessly compressed all105 x4081 gene-contribution table. Exact source/input/model/score/phase hashes and versions. Preserve old outputs and keep large arrays outside Git.
limits: This is a deterministic algebraic explanation of a score mean on shared observed cells, not a causal mediation analysis, independent biological replication, gene-regulatory mechanism, proof of true cycling, or method superiority. Gene covariance and phase-score coverage differ between control and intervention populations. No universal claim of annotation failure or novelty follows from this single component.
